redirect
Description
Redirects an HTTP request to a specific location. The location can be
either a host name or a URI. This is a BIG-IP 4.X statement, provided
for backward compatibility. You can use the equivalent 9.X command
HTTP::redirect
instead.
Syntax
redirect
[
<
host_name
>
|
<
URI
>
]
redirect [<host_name> | <URI>]
Redirects an HTTP request to a specific location.
